objective: learn forward locomotion of a fixed planar biped with a compact phase-based controller
initial_state: torso pitch and 6 joint angles ~ N(0, 0.03 rad) from the episode seed; feet 2 mm above floor
fitness: mean over seeds of: survival + 3*progress + steps - 0.5*effort - pitch_penalty + 1*[walking]; progress/steps are multiplied by a soft validity factor (chatter, flight, slip, saturation, body contact); see creature_forge.locomotion.fitness_components

optimization.shared_initial_population: first 20 candidates are identical for both methods

selection_rule: per method, the candidate with the highest mean TRAINING fitness over the training seeds (ties: earlier evaluated). Diagnostic and held-out seeds are not used.

baselines.open_loop_best_of_500: best-by-fitness open_loop sample in results/diagnosis.json (diagnostic seeds)

heldout_policy: evaluated once, after this file and results/selection.json are committed unmodified; results are reported as-is and never used for selection or tuning
